reason: Stage 4 reconciliation (R-A r1 vs R-B r9, 64/75 fields) failed only on model-prediction fields. A probe showed both paths build an identical design matrix up to column order; at glmnet's default convergence threshold (1e-7) the fit stops before convergence and its predictions depend on column order by up to 0.0715 units (above the 0.05 tolerance); at 1e-12 the difference is 0.0002. Locked §17A.2 sets no convergence threshold. Design text v5.2 (2065773c3224dd6eb083ef6b8f57deb88786ee1742d7da5f66f7fdf825278957) -> v5.3 (d3af4b594a80c8e458d8c41c4829cf1a8e250e0bbdbaf491811c8c26cbdc9a46) adds: "Every glmnet fit (all CV folds and final fits, at every origin) uses convergence threshold thresh = 1e-12. No other model setting changes." Receipt v2 -> v3 updates design_version and decision_rules.model.spec accordingly. No tolerance is changed or waived. Both R paths are to be rebuilt and rerun from fixtures onward.
approval_text: I approve CC-S4-01: add glmnet convergence threshold 1e-12 to §17A.2 and rebuild/rerun both paths.
